parent_objective: audit the terminal-boundary source repair smoke before any candidate materialization or training
blocked_by: terminal history-positive target sides are zero
control intervention margin gaps dominate history-intervention gaps
supersedes: direct continuation from M1541 implementation to materialization

public_gates: M1542 must audit M1541 before any materialization or training
M1542 must classify the source-window miss and control-dominated effects
M1542 must decide whether the next route is task sampling repair, branch synthesis, or stop
M1542 must preserve the P0 actor input contract

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M1541 terminal-boundary repair produced usable history-positive evidence or only a source-window/control artifact
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if terminal target rows do not enter the near-boundary window
stop if the audit would require changing actor inputs or exporting a training corpus
stop after selecting the next route
fallback_plan: route to terminal-boundary task sampling repair if source-window miss is the dominant blocker
route to branch synthesis if another narrow repair would exceed the branch cadence or repeat the same failure
route to stop if terminal-boundary history interventions remain null after clean task sampling
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1541 completed a repair smoke with failed public/evidence gates

admission_evidence: M1541 wrote bounded public repair artifacts with clean guardrails
allowed_updates: M1542 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if the audit admits a route
next_stage_criteria: M1541 source-window and control-dominance failures are classified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1542 is an audit; it must not upgrade M1541's control-dominated public result into history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1541 bounded terminal-boundary public smoke only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Preserve M1541 as a negative result and route to task sampling repair or synthesis instead of weakening thresholds.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1541's negative result can be classified cleanly enough to choose between terminal-boundary task sampling repair and branch synthesis without training or materialization.
success_criteria: M1541 near-boundary, history-positive, control, and guardrail metrics are audited
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit treats M1541 as positive terminal-boundary self-ID evidence
audit routes directly to training promotion private holdout or materialization
audit changes actor inputs or weakens the evidence standard
decision_rule: M1542 passes if it classifies the M1541 result and selects the next route while preserving all no-materialization guardrails.
